Gulshan Kumar in association with Abundantia presents the video song Move Your Lakk composed by Badshah, written by Badshah sung by Diljit Dosanjh, Badshah & Sonakshi Sinha from the upcoming Bollywood movie "NOOR" produced by Bhushan Kumar, Krishan Kumar & Vikram Malhotra. Noor is an upcoming Indian drama film directed by Sunhil Sippy, Starring Sonakshi Sinha in the lead role alongside, Kanan Gill, Shibani Dandekar, Purab Kohli. The film releases on 21 April 2017.
